name: ai-reasoning
title: AI Reasoning
description: A collapsible reasoning trace. The summary shimmers only while the model is working, then settles, reports how long it took and folds away.

props.name: children
props.description: The reasoning trace.

props.name: isStreaming
props.description: True while the model is still reasoning. Drives the shimmer and the summary.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start expanded. Defaults to the value of isStreaming.

props.name: collapseWhenDone
props.description: Collapse once streaming ends, unless the reader has toggled it by hand.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the model spent. Omit to have the component time the stream itself.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.

name: ai-tool-approval
title: AI Tool Approval
description: A card where the user approves or denies an agent's tool call, showing the command or fields, the reason, and a polite live announcement of the decision.

props.name: tool
props.description: The tool's name, such as bash or write_file.

props.name: title
props.description: What the agent wants to do, in plain words.

props.name: input
props.description: A command or text shows as code; an object shows as labelled fields.

props.name: reason
props.description: Why the agent wants this, shown under the input.

props.name: destructive
props.description: Adds a badge and styles the Approve button as destructive.

props.name: decision
props.description: Controls the decision from outside. Leave it out and the card keeps its own.

props.name: approveLabel
props.description: Label of the approve button.

props.name: denyLabel
props.description: Label of the deny button.

props.name: onApprove
props.description: Called when the user approves.

props.name: onDeny
props.description: Called when the user denies.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the card to fade in and fold.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before the card fades in.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables both buttons.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content under the reason, e.g. a diff preview.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the card.

name: uptime-card
title: Uptime Card
description: A status card with a row of daily bars per service, an uptime percentage and a short list of recent incidents. Bars are readable by screen readers and inspectable with the keyboard.

props.name: services
props.description: Each service has a name, a history of daily statuses ('up' | 'degraded' | 'down' | 'none'), an optional uptime override and optional incidents.

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading.

props.name: endDate
props.description: The last day shown, as YYYY-MM-DD (UTC). Defaults to today.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the bars to grow in.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds before the bars start to grow.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns off hover and keyboard inspection.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the card.

name: terminal
title: Terminal
description: A terminal window that plays its lines in sequence: typed commands and fading output. Shows everything at once under reduced motion.

props.name: children
props.description: TerminalLine and TerminalTyping elements, in the order they should appear.

props.name: title
props.description: Text in the title bar.

props.name: sequence
props.description: Play the lines one after another. When off, each line runs on its own delay.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Wait until the terminal scrolls into view.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows every line in full with no animation.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the window.

name: order-book
title: Order Book
description: A depth ladder with asks above and bids below, cumulative depth bars, a spread bar and a fill-cost readout on hover. Driven by snapshots passed as props.

props.name: bids
props.description: Snapshot of buy levels. Equal prices are combined; invalid and zero sizes are dropped.

props.name: asks
props.description: Snapshot of sell levels. Pass new arrays when the book changes.

props.name: levels
props.description: Number of nearest levels to show on each side.

props.name: lastPrice
props.description: Last traded price. Omit to show the midpoint of the best bid and ask.

props.name: baseSymbol
props.description: Symbol of the traded token, e.g. 'ETH'.

props.name: quoteSymbol
props.description: Symbol prices are quoted in.

props.name: formatPrice
props.description: Custom price formatter.

props.name: formatSize
props.description: Custom size formatter.

props.name: onLevelSelect
props.type: (level: { price: number; size: number; total: number }, side: 'bid' | 'ask') => void
props.description: Makes each price a button, for example to fill an order ticket.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the price buttons.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.

name: price-ticker
title: Price Ticker
description: A price that rolls its digits on every update, flashes green or red, and shows a percent change badge.

props.name: value
props.description: Current price.

props.name: previousValue
props.description: Reference for the change badge (e.g. the 24h open). Defaults to the previously shown value.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency code, e.g. 'USD'. Leave empty for a plain number.

props.name: format
props.description: Extra Intl.NumberFormat options. They override currency and decimals.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Fraction digits.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for formatting.

props.name: showChange
props.description: Shows the percent change badge.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, e.g. 'ETH price'.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the digit roll.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.

name: address-chip
title: Address Chip
description: A compact EVM address with a generated blockie-style avatar, copy button, ENS label and explorer link.

props.name: address
props.description: The EVM address, 0x-prefixed.

props.name: chars
props.description: Characters kept on each side of the ellipsis.

props.name: label
props.description: Display name such as an ENS name. The short address moves next to it.

props.name: href
props.description: Explorer link for the address. Opens in a new tab.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Shows the copy button.

props.name: avatar
props.description: Shows the generated avatar.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after the address lands on the clipboard.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.

name: receipt-printer
title: Receipt Printer
description: A transaction receipt (hash, from, to, amount, fee, status) that feeds out of a printer slot one line at a time, with a serrated edge.

props.name: tx
props.type: { hash: string; from: string; to: string; amount: string; symbol: string; fee: string; feeSymbol?: string; status: 'confirmed' | 'pending' | 'failed'; network?: string; timestamp?: string }
props.description: The transaction to print. Amounts are strings so no precision is lost.

props.name: autoPrint
props.description: Print as soon as it mounts. When false the paper waits for the button.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the paper takes to feed out.

props.name: onPrint
props.description: Called each time the printer starts.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.

name: tx-steps
title: Transaction Steps
description: Step-by-step transaction status (Approve, Sign, Broadcast, Confirmed) with a spinning active step, checkmarks and error state.

props.name: steps
props.description: The steps in order, each with its own status.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Stack the steps or lay them out in a row.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the list.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.

name: amount-pad
title: Amount Pad
description: A number pad for entering a token amount: animated digits, presets, a per-transfer cap, shake on refusal and physical keyboard input.

props.name: symbol
props.description: Token or currency symbol, e.g. 'ETH' or '$'.

props.name: symbolPosition
props.description: Draw the symbol before or after the amount.

props.name: max
props.description: Largest amount allowed in one go.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Fraction digits allowed. 0 hides the decimal key.

props.name: balance
props.description: Available balance, shown under the amount until you hit the cap.

props.name: presets
props.description: One-tap amounts.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Label of the submit button; the amount is appended.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the amount when the submit button is pressed.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the done state shows before the pad resets.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every key and the submit button.

props.name: children
props.description: Optional header, e.g. who the amount goes to.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
